description: Basepan Space Challenge Team: Victor Chisom Muojeke, Amalraj Rajesh, Chiemerie Cletus Obijiaku and Olaleye Adeniyi Akinuli. We built NL Fire Calendar, a web app that joins NASA MODIS and VIIRS fire detections into one consistent burning-activity calendar for Newfoundland and Labrador, with area and date selection, a zoomable map, CSV downloads and a carbon monoxide smoke tab.
